transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because… I’ve gotten really slowed down. At work I’ll sit there staring at one audit workpaper for twenty minutes before I even move my hand to type. People are starting to notice I’m not keeping up.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things that you used to find pleasurable, like hobbies, work, or time with friends and family?
Yeah… I guess so. I used to plan hikes, take pictures, cook on Sundays, volunteer at the library. Now it all just feels like… tasks on a list. I don’t really care enough to start any of it.
Have you been feeling more tired or lacking energy lately, even when you haven't done much physically or mentally?
Yeah. Even if I’m in bed all night, I wake up feeling like I’ve been working nonstop for days. Little things… showering, sorting paperwork… they can wear me out.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately?
Yeah… I’m not really hungry much. I kind of make myself eat because I know I’m supposed to. And… my work skirts are looser lately, but I haven’t been trying to lose weight.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About… seven months, I think. Since my husband stopped working after the downsizing.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough, or blamed yourself for things that weren’t your fault?

Yes… I guess. It feels like it’s my fault. Even when my husband shows me the bank balance, I still feel certain I’ve ruined us financially somehow. And at work… my manager says my job isn’t in danger, but I can’t stop thinking they’re quietly putting together proof that I’m incompetent.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the time, nearly every day?
Yeah… most days. I wake up and it’s already there, this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. Like the day’s kind of over before I’ve even gotten up.
Have you noticed that your movements or speech have become noticeably slower or, on the contrary, more restless and agitated than usual?
Yes… slower, I think. At work I’ll just sit there staring at the same audit workpaper for, I don’t know, twenty minutes before I even type anything. People have noticed I’m not keeping up.
Have you had periods like this before, where you felt down, slowed down, and lost interest in things?
I… I’m not sure. I’ve had rough stretches before, I guess, but I don’t really know if they were like this. It’s hard to compare.
Can you recall if you’ve had similar periods of feeling down and losing interest in things before, or is this the first time you’ve felt this way?
I don’t really know. I mean, I’ve been sad before, sure… but I can’t tell if it was the same as this. This feels harder to place.
Have you had any episodes in the past where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble functioning, similar to how you're feeling now?
I don’t really know. I’ve had times where I wasn’t doing great, but… I can’t say if it was like this. I don’t remember it clearly enough.

Can you think back and say for sure whether you’ve had a time before this one where you felt this same way — down, slowed down, and losing interest in things — and then it got better before coming back again?
I can’t say for sure. I don’t really remember it being this clear before… like it went away and then came back. I just don’t know.
Can you remember if you’ve had a period before this one where you felt similarly down, slowed down, and lost interest in things, and then that period went away completely for a while before now?
I don’t really remember it that way. I mean… maybe I’ve had low stretches, but I can’t say there was a time it fully went away and then came back like this.
Can you remember if you’ve had a time before this current period where you felt down, slowed down, and lost interest in things, and that time ended completely before now?
I’m sorry, I just… I don’t remember it clearly enough to say that. I can’t really tell if there was a separate time before that ended completely.
Can you remember if there was ever a time before this current period when you felt down, slowed down, and lost interest in things, and that time completely went away for a while before now?
I really can’t remember a time like that clearly. I know I’ve felt low before, but… not where I can say it completely went away and then came back.
Can you remember if you ever had a time before this current period when you felt down, slowed down, and lost interest in things, and that time ended completely for at least a few months before now?
I don’t think I can say that. I can’t remember a clear break like that for a few months where it was just… gone.
Can you remember if you ever had a time before this current period, where you felt down, slowed down, and lost interest in things, and that time ended completely for at least a few months before now?
I’m not sure. I can’t really point to a time before this where it ended like that for months.

Can you remember if you ever had a time before this current period, lasting at least a couple of weeks, where you felt down, slowed down, and lost interest in things, and that time ended completely before now?
I don’t really remember it that way. I’ve had low times, but I can’t say there was a separate couple-week period that fully ended before this.
